name: Управляемая мина
subject: A low sturdy round iron-and-brass fantasy mine with square bolted plates and a vivid small red central activation gem, beside a leather-gloved teal-sleeved hand holding a compact brass rune detonator. A short red glimmer links hand control to device conceptually without a drawn wire, no tripwire/stepping foot. Mine not exploded yet, no modern electronics or labels. Navy/teal background.
caption: Мина и ручной активатор подчёркивают выбор момента подрыва.
